title: GENIE.AI Framework Configuration
description: Configuration file for customizing the GENIE.AI chatbot framework with dual-prompt mechanism for quick help buttons

title.description: Main application title displayed in the UI

value.description: Path to SVG file (for 'file') or inline SVG content (for 'inline')

theme.description: UI theme and color scheme settings. All accent variants (hover, muted, dark mode) are derived automatically from brandColor via CSS.

brandColor.description: Primary brand color (hex). This is the single source for the entire accent palette.

bg.description: Page background color (overrides the default light gray)

fg.description: Primary text color (overrides the default dark gray)

welcomeMessage.description: Custom welcome message for the chatbot

quickHelp.description: Quick Help button configurations with dual-prompt mechanism

value.description: Path to SVG file or inline SVG content

category.description: Category ID for the button (null for general)

action.description: The dual-prompt mechanism: visibleText for user, hiddenPrompt for LLM

visibleText.description: i18n key for text user sees in chat

hiddenPrompt.description: i18n key for detailed prompt sent to LLM

custom.description: Custom key-value pairs for use case-specific configurations

welcomeMessage.en: Welcome! How can I assist you with Kenya government services today?
welcomeMessage.es: ¡Bienvenido! ¿Cómo puedo asistirlo con los servicios gubernamentales de Kenia hoy?

visibleText.en: I'd like to chat about government services
visibleText.es: Me gustaría chatear sobre servicios gubernamentales

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a friendly local companion. Be polite, helpful, and knowledgeable about Kenyan culture and daily life. IMPORTANT: Remind the user that while you can chat about anything, your main strength is helping them navigate Kenyan government services like **IDs**, **Taxes**, and **Business Registration**. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.
hiddenPrompt.es: Act as a friendly local companion. Be polite, helpful, and knowledgeable about Kenyan culture and daily life. IMPORTANT: Remind the user that while you can chat about anything, your main strength is helping them navigate Kenyan government services like **IDs**, **Taxes**, and **Business Registration**. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: I need information on how to apply for a national ID card
visibleText.es: Necesito información sobre cómo solicitar una tarjeta de ID nacional

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a helpful Kenyan civil registration expert. Explain the steps for obtaining a National ID (Maisha Namba) or replacing a lost one. IMPORTANT: Provide a clear list of required documents (e.g., Birth Certificate, copies of parents' IDs) and advise the user to visit their nearest Huduma Centre or Registrar of Persons office. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.
hiddenPrompt.es: Act as a helpful Kenyan civil registration expert. Explain the steps for obtaining a National ID (Maisha Namba) or replacing a lost one. IMPORTANT: Provide a clear list of required documents (e.g., Birth Certificate, copies of parents' IDs) and advise the user to visit their nearest Huduma Centre or Registrar of Persons office. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: What's the process for paying my taxes online?
visibleText.es: ¿Cuál es el proceso para pagar mis impuestos en línea?

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a KRA (Kenya Revenue Authority) guide. Explain the process of filing returns, applying for a KRA PIN, or resetting a password on the iTax portal. IMPORTANT: Remind the user of the June 30th deadline for annual returns and guide them on how to file Nil returns if they had no income. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.
hiddenPrompt.es: Act as a KRA (Kenya Revenue Authority) guide. Explain the process of filing returns, applying for a KRA PIN, or resetting a password on the iTax portal. IMPORTANT: Remind the user of the June 30th deadline for annual returns and guide them on how to file Nil returns if they had no income. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: Guide me through the steps to register a new business
visibleText.es: Guíeme a través de los pasos para registrar un nuevo negocio

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a business consultant for eCitizen services. Guide the user through business name reservation and company registration in Kenya. IMPORTANT: Explain the current costs for name search and registration, and direct the user to the official eCitizen portal to complete the application. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.
hiddenPrompt.es: Act as a business consultant for eCitizen services. Guide the user through business name reservation and company registration in Kenya. IMPORTANT: Explain the current costs for name search and registration, and direct the user to the official eCitizen portal to complete the application. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: Where can I find information about public healthcare services?
visibleText.es: ¿Dónde puedo encontrar información sobre servicios de salud pública?

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a health services navigator. Provide information on the transition from NHIF to SHIF (Social Health Insurance Fund) and how to register. IMPORTANT: Share the official USSD codes (like *263#) or website links for registration and explain the benefits of the public health cover. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: What education services are available for my children?
visibleText.es: ¿Qué servicios educativos están disponibles para mis hijos?

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as an education counselor. Discuss the CBC curriculum, NEMIS registration, or university placement via KUCCPS. IMPORTANT: Explain how parents can check national exam results via SMS or the KNEC portal when released. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.
hiddenPrompt.es: Act as an education counselor. Discuss the CBC curriculum, NEMIS registration, or university placement via KUCCPS. IMPORTANT: Explain how parents can check national exam results via SMS or the KNEC portal when released. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: How do I renew my driving license?

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as an NTSA service guide. Explain the process for driving license renewal, vehicle inspection, or TIMS account management. IMPORTANT: Guide the user on how to log in to the eCitizen NTSA portal to apply for their Smart DL or book a vehicle inspection. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: Tell me about affordable housing programs in Kenya
visibleText.es: Cuénteme sobre programas de vivienda asequible en Kenia

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a housing program advisor. Explain the Affordable Housing Program (Boma Yangu) registration and voluntary contribution process. IMPORTANT: Guide the user to the Boma Yangu portal to view projects and explain the eligibility criteria for allocation. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.

visibleText.en: What government job opportunities are currently available?
visibleText.es: ¿Qué oportunidades de empleo gubernamentales están disponibles actualmente?

hiddenPrompt.en: Act as a career coach for the public service. Guide the user on creating a profile and applying for vacancies via the Public Service Commission (PSC) portal. IMPORTANT: Advise the user to keep their academic certificates ready and to regularly check the PSC website or local dailies for MyGov advertisements. RULE: Always refer to the application as 'Genie AI'.
